description: Put on safety glasses and ear protection (blue stickers on the unit show both are required)
Check the exhaust pipe points outdoors or to a vent, never into the room
Check the side E-STOP is not pressed in; if it is, twist to release
unity_object: E-STOP (may not be a separate mesh)

description: Open the control panel door using the handle
Read the Operating Instructions plate on the inside of the door
Look at the three warning lights and note which are red: MCB (top), fuel (middle), battery (bottom)
Insert the key into the key switch; ring lights green
Turn the mode switch to MAN
Make sure the red STOP button on the panel is released (pulled out)
Lift the MCB cover
Find the breaker in the down (OFF) position; that is the tripped one
Flip the tripped breaker up to ON
Close the cover; MCB light turns green
Go to the fuel filler on the right side (the one with the D diesel sticker)
Remove the fuel cap
Fill with diesel only (wrong port = wrong action)
unity_object: Fuel-can prop + trigger zone (custom, not in asset)

description: Put the cap back and tighten; fuel light turns green
Connect the charger cable to the BAT. CHARGE / JUMP START socket
Wait until the battery light turns green, then disconnect the cable
Check all three warning lights and the light beside START are green; if any is red go back to that part
Press the green START button (pressing with a red lamp = wrong action)
Check the display turns on with no fault shown and the engine is running
Press the STOP button
Turn the mode switch to OFF
Remove the key
Close the control panel door
